symbols.DateTimeUtil: Kernel class. Kernel types live in the AOS binaries, not in PackagesLocalDirectory metadata XML, so the index cannot carry them (same reason ReferenceResolver allow-lists them).
symbols.Exception: Kernel enum (Exception::Error / ::CLRError). Not an AxEnum on disk.
symbols.JoinMode: Kernel enum used by the Query object model (JoinMode::InnerJoin).
symbols.QueryRun: Kernel class of the Query object model.
symbols.QueryBuildDataSource: Kernel class of the Query object model.
symbols.StreamReader: System.IO.StreamReader, written unqualified after a `using System.IO;` in the example. .NET BCL types are matched by namespace prefix when qualified; this one is not.
symbols.ServiceAttribute: Named by custom-service-authoring only in order to state that no such class-level decorator exists in X++. The corpus is right precisely because this does not resolve.
